final: WITH country_avgs AS (SELECT c.country, AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins FROM constructorStandings cs JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY c.country), all_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS mean_wins FROM country_avgs), above_all AS (SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_wins, am.mean_wins FROM country_avgs ca CROSS JOIN all_mean am WHERE ca.avg_wins > am.mean_wins), above_group AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS mean_wins FROM above_all), final_countries AS (SELECT ag.avg_wins, ag.mean_wins AS all_mean, bg.mean_wins AS group_mean FROM above_all ag CROSS JOIN above_group bg WHERE ag.avg_wins > bg.mean_wins) SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS mean_final_avg_wins, AVG(avg_wins - all_mean) AS mean_excess_over_all_country_mean, AVG(avg_wins - group_mean) AS mean_excess_over_above_average_group_mean FROM final_countries
